notes.title: Release v1.1
notes.notes: [p]The first major update since v1.0, v1.1 replaces the game’s entire audio backend, brings [b]native Linux support[/b], and introduces a more scalable foundation for the future—without impacting current gameplay or visuals. While light on content, this release modernizes key systems and addresses long-standing compatibility issues.[/p][p][/p][p]🔊 [u]New Audio System[/u][/p][p]The entire audio backend has been replaced with a custom-built sound manager, powered by [url="https://github.com/finnkuusisto/TinySound"]TinySound[/url]. This change brings:[/p][list][*][p]Lower latency, cleaner audio playback[/p][/*][*][p]Complete removal of JavaFX MediaPlayer dependency[/p][/*][*][p]All sounds converted from .mp3 to .wav[/p][/*][/list][p]You should notice cleaner, more responsive audio, especially during heavy gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]🐧 [u]Native Linux Support[/u][/p][p]Nocturne FX™ now supports native Linux builds, available directly via Steam.[/p][list][*][p]Linux support was previously deferred due to incompatibility with JavaFX MediaPlayer[/p][/*][*][p]With the new sound system, Linux now runs without requiring per-player patching[/p][/*][*][p]A new [b]game.log[/b] file captures any terminal output for easier debugging[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚠️ [u]Known Issues[/u][/p][p]Linux support is currently experimental. These known issues will be fixed in future patches:[/p][list][*][p]Emojis may not display properly on some systems[/p][/*][*][p]UI scale may appear much larger or smaller than intended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Questions? Bug Reports?[/p][p]📩 Reach out: [url="https://contact.nocturnefx@gmail.com"]contact.nocturnefx@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Release v1.0
notes.notes:
[p][b]Nocturne FX™ is now officially out of Early Access.[/b]
After months of iteration, testing, and polish, v1.0 marks the stabilization of all core systems: visuals, gameplay, performance, and configuration. While new features may still arrive in the future, this release signifies a fully playable and technically complete product.[/p][p]Expect smooth frame pacing, enhanced audio control, improved UI behavior, and refined performance backed by internal static analysis and feedback-driven tuning.[/p][p][/p][p]💸 [u]Now Just $2.99[/u][/p][p]To celebrate the full release, the price has been permanently dropped to [b]$2.99 USD[/b]. Thanks to everyone who supported the project through Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]🧠 [u]Engine & Architecture[/u][/p][p]A new optional FPS cap is now available when VSync Emulation is enabled:[/p][list][*][p]Configurable between 1 FPS and your display’s refresh rate[/p][/*][*][p]Use -1 to uncap[/p][/*][*][p]Useful for limiting resource use or stabilizing pacing on unstable variable-refresh displays[/p][/*][*][p]This is [b]uncapped by default[/b] but can be toggled in the settings menu[/p][/*][/list][p]Menu System Refactor:[/p][list][*][p]Menu logic now uses a dedicated internal enumumerator system[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces per-frame overhead and improves UI responsiveness[/p][/*][/list][p]Removed Screen Diagonal Scaling:[/p][list][*][p]UI sizing no longer relies on screen diagonal calculations[/p][/*][*][p]Button sizes and other elements now appear consistent regardless of resolution or aspect ratio[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🛠️ [u]Developer & Debug Improvements[/u][/p][p]Static Analysis Clean Pass:[/p][list][*][p]Any remaining issues from static analysis tools have been resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Backend code is now cleaner, safer, and easier to maintain[/p][/*][/list][p]Frame Cap Logic Integrated:[/p][list][*][p]Frame cap state is now logged in exported performance metadata[/p][/*][*][p]Enables more accurate profiling for both players and developers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]📊 [u]Miscellaneous[/u][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]FPS now correctly displays refresh rate when maxed (not +1)[/p][/*][*][p]The back button inside the settings menu not displaying a tooltip has been resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Player no longer remains shrunk after dying while under shrink effect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Have feedback? Found an edge case?[/p][p]📨 Reach out: [url="https://contact.nocturnefx@gmail.com"]contact.nocturnefx@gmail.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.90.2 (Early Access Update 5)
notes.notes: [p]This fifth update since Early Access doesn’t bring new content, but it continues to refine Nocturne FX™ under the hood—with new settings, engine fixes, and better tooling for both players and development. Most of these changes enhance flexibility, improve sound and visual consistency, or support future expansion.[/p][p][/p][p]🧠 [u]Engine & Logic Fixes[/u][/p][p]Camera wrapping fixed: Visual issues beyond 100,000 units (clouds failing, stars shifting) have been resolved.[/p][p]Wrap boundary increased: From 100,000 → 1,000,000 units to delay coordinate overflows far beyond normal runs.[/p][p]Settings system upgraded: Now supports more than booleans, which opens the door for future numeric or typed configuration fields without boilerplate.[/p][p][/p][p]🔊 [u]Master Volume Control[/u][/p][p]Added a new Master Volume setting (0–100), allowing overall audio scaling while keeping the balance between sounds (e.g. pew is louder than flap).[/p][p]Enables dynamic tuning without distorting mix levels.[/p][p]This is the first feature built using the new settings system.[/p][p][/p][p]🧾 [u]Debug Console Enhancement[/u][/p][p]Output now duplicates to both the in-game console and system stdout/stderr.[/p][p]Ensures error messages or crash info is preserved—even when the debug UI is open.[/p][p][/p][p]📊 [u]Run Summary Tweak[/u][/p][p]Score is now included in the optional end-of-run summary.[/p][p]Previously showed only time, flaps, and power-ups—this change reflects direct player feedback.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.90.1 (Early Access Update 4)
notes.notes: [p]This fourth update since Early Access doesn't bring new content, but it does significantly enhance the game’s underlying performance. Whether you're on a high-refresh display or an older laptop, you should notice smoother, more consistent gameplay across the board.[/p][p][/p][p]⚙️ [u]Major Performance Improvements[/u][/p][p]A new software-based VSync emulation system has been implemented, offering precise frame pacing, timing drift correction, and hybrid sleep/spin logic, resulting in:[/p][list][*][p]Frame delivery is now smoother and more consistent[/p][/*][*][p]CPU usage is cut nearly in half on average[/p][/*][*][p]1% Low FPS has improved dramatically, especially at high refresh rates[/p][/*][/list][p]This system is [b]enabled by default[/b]. While you can disable it in the settings, it’s [b]not recommended[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]🖥️ [u]VRR Support[/u][/p][p]A new “VRR Support” option allows per-frame refresh rate detection, improving compatibility with GSync, FreeSync, and other variable refresh displays.[/p][p]This is [b]disabled by default[/b] but can be toggled in the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p]🔒 [u]Frame Profiling[/u][/p][p]The old "Show FPS" option has been replaced with "Show Performance Metrics", now displaying both average FPS and a rolling 30-second 1% Low FPS.[/p][p]Press［TAB］in the debug menu to export a detailed benchmark JSON to the new frame_profiles folder, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]Timestamped frame timing data from the past 5 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Heap usage[/p][/*][*][p]Detected spikes[/p][/*][*][p]Additional metrics[/p][/*][/list][p]Note:[/p][list][*][p]Frame data is reset every run[/p][/*][*][p]Only active gameplay records frames (not during pause, game over, or menus)[/p][/*][*][p]For uninterrupted benchmarking, it is recommended to use［G］godmode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🌠 [u]Other Fixes and Improvements[/u][/p][p]Stars now fade out properly when night turns to day instead of disappearing instantaneously.[/p][p]Rare rain restart issue fixed (added cooldown between weather events).[/p][p]The debug menu log activation message now correctly persists.[/p][p]The settings menu has been updated with better descriptions and tooltips.[/p][p]Launch4j packaging corrected to eliminate redundant packaging, reducing file size.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.9 (Early Access Update 3)
notes.notes: [p]This third update since Early Access launch brings sweeping improvements to game systems, visuals, and performance—alongside new security architecture to protect the integrity of the experience.[/p][p][/p][p]🖼️ [u]Main Menu Customization[/u][/p][p]All menu buttons have been redesigned, replacing the default, generic JavaFX buttons.[/p][p]Market menu and back buttons have been resized for cleaner layout.[/p][p][/p][p]🌧️ [u]Dynamic Rain Overhaul[/u][/p][p]Rain has been transformed from a binary effect into a state-based system, allowing smooth transitions between weather phases.[/p][p]The rain palette effect has been expanded.[/p][p]Procedural raindrop spawning has been refined for better realism.[/p][p][/p][p]🎲 [u]Smarter Randomness[/u][/p][p]All randomness systems have been rebuilt using a modern, centralized randomization factory based on Xoshiro256PlusPlus.[/p][p]Enhances gameplay consistency, balancing, and lays groundwork for seeding and replay support in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]🔴 [u]Red Pipe Behavior Mutation[/u][/p][p]Red pipes may now rarely oscillate once a certain point threshold has been reached.[/p][p][/p][p]🎵 [u]Music System Enhancements[/u][/p][p]A new chaos track has been added.[/p][p]All music now uses .wav format to eliminate stuttering or load delays.[/p][p]Music and sound effects can now be toggled independently in the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ [u]Miscellaneous Changes and Bug Fixes[/u][/p][p]Fixed flickering popup text at the top left of the screen.[/p][p]Resolved an error related to rainbow music not stopping when a new high score is achieved.[/p][p]Fixed a settings synchronization issue.[/p][p]Implemented new fallback systems for data recovery.[/p][p]Overhauled file security.[/p][p]Various minor improvements and fixes.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.89.9 (Early Access Update 2)
notes.notes: [p]This second update since Early Access launch brings new features and a number of fixes, tweaks, and key improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]🔫 [u]New Power Up: Gun[/u][/p][p]Purchase use tickets in the market for 10 gold each and activate with the［P］key — or wait for it to spawn naturally.[/p][p]Auto-fire alien phaser beams every 1.5 seconds for a total of eight phaser beams to obliterate pipes and damage special encounters.[/p][p][/p][p]🏆 [u]New Achievement: Gunslinger[/u][/p][p]Survive the attack on Ultranightmare using a gun to earn this challenge reward and gain 20 XP and 10 gold.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [u]Massive Input Overhaul[/u][/p][p]Input handling has been completely refactored. Expect cleaner controls, better state accuracy, and no more accidental flaps after unpausing or restarting.[/p][p]The debug keys for chaos and time adjustment can now be held for easier tuning and better experimentation.[/p][p][/p][p]🔊 [u]Sound Polish[/u][/p][p]Background music volume lowered from 0.33 → 0.25.[/p][p]XP sound volume increased from 1 → 1.25.[/p][p]New "pew" sound introduced with gun.[/p][p][/p][p]🧾 [u]Misc Improvements[/u][/p][p]Version display now matches patch format.[/p][p]Unified exit logic and UI alignment polish.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.89.8 (Early Access Update 1)
notes.notes: [p]This first update since Early Access launch brings a handful of key improvements based on feedback and internal polish.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [u]Input Handling Fixes[/u][/p][p]Held key inputs are now fully blocked — no more double-flaps or sticky restarts. Controls should feel tighter and more reliable across the board.[/p][p]Unpause-To-Flap cooldown removed.[/p][p]Key combinations now possible for future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]💥 [u]Shockwave Rebalance[/u][/p][p]Shockwave scoring now scales with difficulty:[/p][list][*][p] 5 pts – Baby & Regular (unchanged)[/p][/*][*][p] 10 pts – Ultranightmare[/p][/*][*][p] 25 pts – Pipe Madness[/p][/*][/list][p]You’ll now earn closer to what you would’ve scored by threading the pipes instead of blowing them away.[/p][p][/p][p]🌆 [u]Visual Improvements[/u][/p][p]Fixed spacing on house windows. Minor tweaks to skyline clarity and UI layering.[/p][p][/p][p]🧹 [u]Other Improvements[/u][/p][p]Continued clarity passes on the codebase.[/p][p]Minor bugfixes that didn’t deserve a spotlight, but still matter.  [/p]

notes.title: Nocturne FX™ is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
The first public release of Nocturne FX™ is now live.

This Early Access version is fully playable, stable, and content-complete. Developed from the ground up since April 30th, 2025 using raw JavaFX, Nocturne FX™ delivers a chaos-driven experience designed for fast, challenging, and tightly tuned gameplay.

To celebrate the launch, the game is available at 40% off for the first 10 days of Early Access.

Development during Early Access will focus on refinement, stability, and minor adjustments based on player feedback. Some content expansions may happen—keep an eye out.

Feedback is welcome and can be sent to contact.nocturnefx@gmail.com.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Nocturne FX™ Launches into Early Access on May 30th!
notes.notes:
Nocturne FX™, a high-intensity 2D arcade game driven by chaos, power-ups, and procedural hazards, officially launches into Early Access on May 30th. Built entirely in JavaFX, this solo-developed engine delivers emergent gameplay, tight controls, and a growing list of wild, world-altering mechanics.

Launching with a limited-time 40% discount, this release marks the beginning of a living system—expect new content, new mutations of the chaos system, and full Linux/macOS support in post-launch updates.
